# Impulse Gamer — Andrew B’s review

- Original source: [Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood](https://www.impulsegamer.com/igversion01/pc/pcrobinhoodlegendofsherwood.htm)
- Author / publication: Andrew B; Impulse Gamer.
- Language / date: English; displayed date 5 January 2002, chronologically suspect.
- Access: Complete review text and score inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Andrew B awards 9.2/10, praising mission choice, complementary abilities, camp management, music, and richly detailed backgrounds. The review describes a more forgiving combat system than comparable tactical games while retaining a reputational cost for killing. Pixelation when zooming and the learning curve of the controls are noted.

The page’s January 2002 date conflicts with the game’s later release chronology and is preserved as displayed rather than silently corrected. It also mistakenly credits Spellbound with Commandos. These errors limit its use as development history, although the text remains useful evidence of enthusiastic reception.
